summary: Allow people and agents to perform mission-step work while keeping wake assignments agent-only

schema.detail: No database schema or migration changes; this updates the published client JSON schema.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or coordinated member upgrade changes.

compatibility.detail: The client contract now accepts agent or person references for mission-step assignees and claimants, including current-step run summaries. MissionWake remains agent-only. Older strict clients may reject person references in these work fields; mixed client versions were not tested.

manual.detail: No installation or data migration steps required; consumers validating these work fields should use the updated contract.

recovery.detail: No database or runtime recovery changes; older contract validators can still reject person work references.
